# Hi! I'm Álvaro Brey.

I am a **senior Android engineer** from Santiago de Compostela, Spain. I am mainly an Android developer, but I have experience and training in other areas and technologies such as DevOps, web frontend and scripting.

I am passionate about **automation** and **clean code**. As a consequence, I am very interested in strongly automated development processes (CI/CD), containerization and other ways to improve code quality and developer experience.

---

# About me

I am **Álvaro** [[**al** - βa - ɾo](https://youtu.be/uq-gYOrU8bA)]. I am a software engineer from Santiago de Compostela, Spain. I enjoy trying new technologies and as a consequence I have a somewhat generalist background. However, most of my experience is in Android development.

As a developer, I am guided by the DRY principle and strongly dislike duplication of both code and work. Partly due to this, I am proactive about **automating** tasks and processes whenever I can. This is something I apply in my daily work by authoring scripts, containers, CI and tooling config, etc. Several of my published [repos](https://github.com/alvarobrey) also focus on automation or developer experience.

I am also an advocate for **open-source** software. A significant part of my career has been spent working on open-source projects, and I also [publish most of my personal projects](https://github.com/alvarobrey) (like [this page!](https://github.com/alvarobrey/alvarobrey.github.io)) for whoever might find them useful, and contribute to third-party repos.

When I'm not coding, you can probably find me playing [disc golf](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Disc_golf) or video games, messing around with a 3d printer, playing with my dog, or trying to automate physical things with [Home Assistant](https://www.home-assistant.io/).

## What I do

- Android
- Kotlin, Compose
- Shell, Python
- Docker
- Git
- Linux
- VueJS, Typescript
- Ansible

## What I like

- Automation
- Clean and readable code
- Open source software
- Functional programming
- Reproducible builds, containers
- Spontaneous pair programming

## Work

### Senior SDK Engineer

[RevenueCat](https://www.revenuecat.com) | 2026/06 - Present

Senior SDK Engineer at RevenueCat, where we help developers make more money. Work across the RevenueCat SDK family (Android, iOS, web, and the Flutter, React Native, KMP, Unity and Capacitor hybrids), with Android as the primary focus. Includes new feature development, public API design with strong backwards-compatibility guarantees, and performance work. Coordinate cross-platform contracts with and land behaviour changes consistently across every SDK. Contributor to CI, release automation and internal tooling shared across all SDK repositories.

### Senior Android Engineer

[Cabify](https://cabify.com) | 2023/03 - 2026/06

Senior Android Engineer at Cabify, multi-mobility platform for people and parcels. Work on the main Rider public app, with millions of active users. Includes new feature development, maintenance and release management. Frequent contributor to process improvements, CI, and code sharing. Early adopter of AI tools, contributing rules, skills and setting up integrations.

# About this page

This page was developed using [SvelteKit](https://svelte.dev/docs/kit) as a static build framework, TypeScript as the main language and [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com/) for styling.

You can check out the source code [at GitHub](https://github.com/alvarobrey/alvarobrey.github.io), where it is published under the GNU GPLv3 License. The page is automatically built as a full static site with [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/alvarobrey/alvarobrey.github.io/actions) and hosted in GitHub Pages.

# Privacy

alvarobrey.com is a personal site. It has no accounts, no forms, no advertising and no tracking cookies. This page describes the little data that is collected when you visit.

## What your browser stores

One value, under the key `alvarobrey.com.darkTheme`, remembering whether you picked the light or the dark theme. It stays in your browser, is never sent anywhere, and clearing your site data removes it.

## Analytics

The site loads [Cloudflare Web Analytics](https://www.cloudflare.com/web-analytics/), which counts page views without cookies and without fingerprinting visitors. It records the page URL, the referrer, and coarse details such as browser and country. It does not build a profile of you, and I cannot identify you from it.

## Hosting

The site is a set of static files served by [GitHub Pages](https://pages.github.com/) through [Cloudflare](https://www.cloudflare.com/). Both keep short-lived server logs, including IP addresses, for operations and abuse prevention, under their own privacy policies.

## Links away from here

Pages here link out to GitHub, LinkedIn and elsewhere. Once you follow one of those links, that site's own privacy policy applies instead of this one.

## Questions

Nothing collected here is sold or shared with anyone. If you have a question about any of it, [get in touch](https://alvarobrey.com/contact).
